card.title: Before We Knew
card.instruction: Return emotionally to the time before a difficult truth changed what you could believe, trust, or say openly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could the club's victory bunting stay up until tea? I liked us before we knew about the altered scores.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The visiting team arrives in ten minutes. We owe them the trophy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I just remember hanging this with you. We hugged on a stepladder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hold it while you take the bunting down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you hug me first? Same ladder. Less to celebrate.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asks to prolong pre-disclosure victory feeling, A3 recalls the shared bunting hug, and A5 requests that old closeness before dismantling the false celebration.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's return-the-trophy deadline makes A3 acknowledge the truth while naming the memory; B4's ladder help causes A5's same-ladder hug request.

relationship.evidence: B2 states the obligation to the visiting team and B4 offers to help take the bunting down.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's practical dismantling support to recover one earlier emotional gesture without retaining the cheated trophy.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes altered scores and victory bunting; B2 identifies the immediate rightful-return task.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's same-ladder-less-to-celebrate ending is earned by A3's old hug and B4's current help.
